rule_title: TTP T1070.006 - System Time Set via PowerShell (EID 4616)
description: High-fidelity detection for clock manipulation via PowerShell — the method used in this sample. Set-Date, [System.DateTime], and the Win32 SetSystemTime API called from PowerShell all produce EID 4616 with ProcessName pointing to powershell.exe. No legitimate administrative workflow requires setting the system clock from PowerShell on a domain-joined machine where W32tm handles time synchronisation. A PowerShell process as the clock-changer is near-certain malicious intent.
